name: Plant for the Planet Matching Grants
summary: One-year matching grants for nonprofits and local government programmes with a tree-planting record, funding urban, suburban or rural planting in forests, parks and along roadways in the LG&E, KU or ODP service territory.

geography.label: LG&E, KU or ODP service territory

eligibility.rule: Is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization or a local government program
Has a demonstrated history of successful tree-planting efforts
Is not a neighborhood association or religious organization
Demonstrates that mature trees will not interfere with utility lines

status.quote: Plant for the Planet Matching Grant applications will be accepted in October of 2026.

applicant_types.quote: be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization or a local government program

geography.quote: be located within the LG&E, KU or ODP service territory

access.quote: Grant applications will be accepted through our online grant portal.

window.quote: Plant for the Planet Matching Grant applications will be accepted in October of 2026.

amount.quote: LG&E and KU offer one-year matching grants of $500 up to $5,000

co_finance_required.quote: LG&E and KU offer one-year matching grants of $500 up to $5,000

effort.quote: Grant applications will be accepted through our online grant portal.

eligibility.quote: be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization or a local government program;
have a demonstrated history of successful tree-planting efforts.
Neighborhood associations and religious organizations are not eligible for this grant.
Applicants must demonstrate that mature trees resulting from their efforts will not interfere with utility lines.
